description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigFileAPI class in the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the installer upgrade API namespace. It provides RESTful endpoints for handling configuration file operations during the upgrade process, including setting database info, writing config files, and sending registration data. The class interacts with system configuration, data registration utilities, and the database connection, and handles exceptions with logging.

classes.name: ConfigFileAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller for handling configuration file operations during the system upgrade process in OrangeHRM. It manages writing config files, setting database info, and sending registration data, extending the abstract base class of installer REST controllers.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to process configuration steps such as writing config files and database connection verification during upgrade.

methods.name: sendRegistrationData
methods.description: Sends registration data to an external service, including handling registration events and success data.

methods.name: getRegistrationType
methods.description: Returns the integer constant representing the registration type 'upgrader started'.
